accordions.title: What are the advantages of Bremsor caliper covers compared to other brands?
accordions.description:
Bremsor caliper covers stand out through a combination of custom fit, premium materials, and lasting performance. Unlike plastic covers that melt or crack and metal ones that rattle and damage your calipers, our covers are made from high-grade TFRP fiberglass — a lightweight, heat-resistant material tested on sports cars for years.

Each set is custom-designed for your exact make, model, and year to ensure a secure, seamless fit—not a generic one-size solution. Bremsor covers feature a sleek, high-gloss finish, are easy to install, and provide long-term protection against dust, debris, rust, and fading. We also offer color and logo customization, and back every set with a 2-year warranty.

In short: They look better, last longer, and fit like they're factory-made.

accordions.title: What materials are used in Bremsor caliper covers?
accordions.description: Bremsor covers are made from TFRP fiberglass, the most premium and heat-resistant fiberglass available on the market. Unlike plastic or metal alternatives, our covers are tested for long-term durability and safety on high-performance sports cars. Each set is backed by a 2-year warranty, included in the price.

accordions.title: Are the covers designed for specific vehicle makes and models?
accordions.description: Yes, our caliper covers are custom-designed for each make, model, and year to ensure the best fit and performance.

accordions.title: Are the covers heat-resistant?
accordions.description: Yes, our covers are made from 100% heat-resistant TFRP fiberglass. Some designs include vent holes, allowing air to flow through and reduce heat buildup, which contributes to both safety and durability.

accordions.title: How can customers ensure the covers will fit their specific vehicle?
accordions.description: We ask customers to provide photos of their front and rear wheels with visible calipers during the order process to help ensure proper fitment.

accordions.title: What if the covers don't fit after all?
accordions.description: If you experience any fitment issues, please take clear photos and videos during the installation process and share them with us. If there is a genuine problem, we'll be happy to offer a free replacement or a full refund. Your satisfaction is our priority, and we stand behind every custom order.

accordions.title: What if my vehicle isn't listed on the website?
accordions.description: If your vehicle isn't listed, you can still place an order by contacting us directly or submitting a custom request form. We produce caliper covers for all makes and models.

accordions.title: Do I need to remove covers when replacing brake pads?
accordions.description: In most cases, you do not need to remove the covers when changing brake pads, as there is access from the back. If needed, the covers can be removed easily using light pressure and glue removal spray. Watch the removal video for guidance

accordions.title: What customization options are available?
accordions.description: Customers can choose from a variety of colors, logos, and text options to personalize their caliper covers.

accordions.title: Is there an additional charge for custom colors?
accordions.description: We charge only $15 extra for non-default or fully custom color options.

accordions.title: How can I submit a custom design request?
accordions.description: You can fill out our custom order request form, or contact us via phone, email, or chat to discuss your design.

accordions.title: How can I check the status of my order?
accordions.description: You'll receive email updates with tracking details. You can also request a live update through our website's chat feature.

accordions.title: Can I modify or cancel my order after placing it?
accordions.description: Yes, you may cancel or modify your order within 24 hours of placing it.

accordions.title: Can I update my shipping address after placing an order?
accordions.description: Yes, shipping addresses can be updated within 48 hours of placing the order.

accordions.title: Do you offer any discounts?
accordions.description: Yes, we occasionally run sales and special offers. To stay updated, sign up for our email and SMS list. We also offer a $50 credit in exchange for high-quality photo and video content with usage rights. Read more here.

accordions.title: Do you work with creators?
accordions.description: Yes! We're always open to potential partnerships. We also offer a $50 reward to customers who provide high-quality content with usage rights. Read more here.

accordions.title: Do you offer discounts for wholesale orders?
accordions.description:
Yes. Our standard retail price starts at $285 per set of 4, and we offer the following discounts for bulk purchases:

  • 5% OFF on 10+ sets
  • 10% OFF on 25+ sets
  • 15% OFF on 50+ sets
  • 20% OFF on 100+ sets

Read more here.

accordions.title: Can we sell your products on our website?
accordions.description: Yes, we're happy to discuss resale partnerships. Please reach out with your company details and we'll be in touch to discuss further.

accordions.title: What are your shipping options and costs?
accordions.description: We offer free standard shipping on all orders.

accordions.title: Do you ship internationally?
accordions.description: Yes, and it's free worldwide.

accordions.title: How long does delivery take?
accordions.description: Delivery typically takes 3–7 business days depending on stock availability and whether customization is required.

accordions.title: What does the 2-year warranty cover?
accordions.description: Our warranty covers loss or damage. We also offer a free replacement if there are any fitment issues.

accordions.title: How do I start a warranty claim?
accordions.description: Please submit your claim through our contact form or by reaching out to us via live chat, phone or email.

accordions.title: What information is needed for a warranty claim?
accordions.description: To process a claim, include your proof of purchase, vehicle details, and a brief description of the issue.

accordions.title: Does installing caliper covers affect my vehicle's warranty?
accordions.description: No, installing Bremsor covers does not affect your vehicle's warranty. The covers are removable with glue removal spray and leave no trace. However, painting the calipers directly may void certain warranties.

accordions.title: How do I install Bremsor caliper covers?
accordions.description: The covers are installed using auto glass glue, similar to windshield adhesive (such as 3M Auto Glass Urethane). This ensures a strong, heat-resistant bond. We've tested our covers on high-performance sports cars, and they stay in place until intentionally removed.

accordions.title: What tools or materials are needed for installation?
accordions.description:
You'll need:

  • Lug wrench or impact wrench
  • Automotive glass adhesive (e.g., 3M)
  • Isopropyl alcohol (rubbing alcohol)
  • Car jack and jack stands

accordions.title: Are the covers removable?
accordions.description: Yes. The covers can be removed using a pressure and glue removal spray.

accordions.title: Do you offer installment payments?
accordions.description: Yes, we offer installment payment options through Shop Pay and Affirm.

accordions.title: What is your return window?
accordions.description: We accept returns within 30 days of delivery.

accordions.title: What is your return policy?
accordions.description: You can find our full return policy here.

accordions.title: Can I return a custom order?
accordions.description: Custom orders are non-refundable, but we may offer a replacement.

accordions.title: How do I request a return or refund?
accordions.description: Please contact us through the contact form on our website or reach out directly.
